title: Market Research slice trends (mr.trends/1)
description: Monthly additive counts. Each row is [month_index, restriction_index, ...columns]. Sum rows over any months, ban lists or tier groups, then divide sums.

schema.description: Schema ID and major version of this file.

version.description: Snapshot version this file belongs to: the UTC start time of the pipeline run that published it, as YYYY-MM-DDTHHMMSSZ. Same as the v=<version>/ folder the file is in and the manifest's version.

side.description: Side this slice covers: corp or runner.

restriction.description: Ban list of this slice: a NetrunnerDB Standard restriction ID (e.g. standard_ban_list_26_05), or all for every ban list combined.

tier_group.description: Tier group of this slice (an id from the manifest's tier_groups, e.g. gnk, store, megacity, online), or all for every tier combined.

months.description: Every month of the snapshot (the manifest's months). The first number of each row indexes this list.

restrictions.description: Ban lists of the snapshot, oldest first (without all). The second number of each row indexes this list.

columns.description: Names of the numbers in each card row after [month_index, restriction_index]: decks with the card, copies summed over them, decks with 1 / 2 / 3+ copies, games and wins (a draw is half a win) of those decks, entries with the card in high-coverage tournaments and how many made the cut, and high-coverage tournaments where the card was played.

baseline_columns.description: Names of the numbers in each baseline row after [month_index, restriction_index]: the side's decks, games and wins where its deck is known, high-coverage entries and how many made the cut, tournaments, high-coverage tournaments, and every game and win of the side (deck known or not).

baseline.description: Side totals per month and ban list: rows of [month_index, restriction_index, ...baseline_columns]. Only month and ban list pairs with data have a row. In cut/trends.json, over top-cut decks only.

cards.description: Per card ID, rows of [month_index, restriction_index, ...columns], one per month and ban list in which the card was played. All numbers are additive: sum rows over any months, ban lists or tier groups, then divide the sums (e.g. popularity = sum of decks_with_card / sum of side_decks).
